title: Water from the Rock and Battle with Amalek

questions.question: What did the Israelites quarrel with Moses about at Rephidim?
questions.explanation: Exodus 17:2 (ESV): "The people quarreled with Moses and said, 'Give us water to drink.'"

questions.question: What did God tell Moses to strike to get water?
questions.explanation: Exodus 17:6 (ESV): "Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock at Horeb, and you shall strike the rock, and water shall come out of it."

questions.question: Who attacked the Israelites at Rephidim?
questions.explanation: Exodus 17:8 (ESV): "Then Amalek came and fought with Israel at Rephidim."

questions.question: Who led the Israelite army against Amalek?
questions.explanation: Exodus 17:9 (ESV): "Moses said to Joshua, 'Choose for us men, and go out and fight with Amalek.'"

questions.question: What happened when Moses held up his hands during the battle?
questions.explanation: Exodus 17:11 (ESV): "Whenever Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed."

questions.question: Who held up Moses' arms when they grew tired?
questions.explanation: Exodus 17:12 (ESV): "Aaron and Hur held up his hands, one on one side, and the other on the other side."

questions.question: What did Moses sit on when his arms grew tired?
questions.explanation: Exodus 17:12 (ESV): "They took a stone and put it under him, and he sat on it."

questions.question: What two names did Moses give the place where they quarreled about water?
questions.explanation: Exodus 17:7 (ESV): "He called the name of the place Massah and Meribah."

questions.question: What did the people say in testing the Lord at Massah?
options: Is the Lord among us or not?
questions.correctAnswer: Is the Lord among us or not?
questions.explanation: Exodus 17:7 (ESV): "Because they tested the Lord by saying, 'Is the Lord among us or not?'"

questions.question: What name did Moses give the altar he built?
questions.explanation: Exodus 17:15 (ESV): "Moses built an altar and called the name of it, The Lord Is My Banner."

questions.question: What did God command Moses to write as a memorial against Amalek?
options: That He would utterly blot out the memory of Amalek
questions.correctAnswer: That He would utterly blot out the memory of Amalek
questions.explanation: Exodus 17:14 (ESV): "Write this as a memorial in a book... I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven."

questions.question: What did Moses take in his hand when going to the rock at Horeb?
options: The staff with which he struck the Nile
questions.correctAnswer: The staff with which he struck the Nile
questions.explanation: Exodus 17:5 (ESV): "Take in your hand the staff with which you struck the Nile, and go."

questions.question: Who was told to go with Moses, along with elders, to the rock?
options: Some of the elders of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Some of the elders of Israel
questions.explanation: Exodus 17:5-6 (ESV): "Take with you some of the elders of Israel... and strike the rock."

questions.question: Until when did Moses' hands remain steady?
options: Until the going down of the sun
questions.correctAnswer: Until the going down of the sun
questions.explanation: Exodus 17:12 (ESV): "So his hands were steady until the going down of the sun."

questions.question: How did Joshua defeat Amalek?
options: He overwhelmed Amalek and his people with the sword
questions.correctAnswer: He overwhelmed Amalek and his people with the sword
questions.explanation: Exodus 17:13 (ESV): "And Joshua overwhelmed Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword."

key_verse_text: And Moses built an altar and called the name of it, The Lord Is My Banner.
